title: 第9章  红颜祸水
slug: 凡人从拔刀三十万次开始
content_zh:
“甜甜，不要胡说。”
苏晴柔连忙出声，语气严厉。
陈时安尴尬地咳嗽了一声，“丫头，凡事不能只看表象，你看到的，不一定就是真实的。
小叔为人低调，暗地里用功的时候，从来不让人看见。”
陈甜甜把小嘴一撇，正要反驳，却是被苏晴柔给拉出了厨房。
“小叔，甜甜打小被她爹给惯坏了，一张嘴不饶人，你可千万不要放在心上。”苏晴柔快步回来，连声道歉。
陈时安摇摇头，“嫂子，你不要这么小心翼翼的，甜甜是我侄女，我如何会怪她。
大哥不在了，以后，我会保护你们娘俩。”
闻言，苏晴柔眨了眨眼睛，眼底隐隐有水汽升起。
“嫂子，制作辣椒酱的手艺，你可别教给别人，这是能赚银子的大买卖。”
陈时安将半袋黄豆放到了灶台上，“制作辣椒酱，豆豉很重要。
你买的豆豉还不错，但还差了点意思。
以后，你制作辣椒酱的时候，需要自己制作豆豉。”
苏晴柔面现惭愧之色，“我以前也做过豆豉，但味道实在太差，我做不好。”
陈时安微微一笑，“不是还有我么？我看着你做，需要改进的地方，我会跟你说。”
说完，他找来一只水桶，将黄豆倒了进去，“豆子浸泡的时间很重要，夏天的时候，需要三到四个时辰，现在是冬天，时间则需要翻倍。
现在浸泡，明天午间的时候，我们就可以开始制作了。”
苏晴柔面露恍然之色，“原来要浸泡这么久，我一开始就错了。
这些事情，也是你从书上学来的？
这是什么书，我怎么没有见过，城寨有卖么？”

陈时安挠了挠脑袋，“我看的书太杂，具体是什么书，我也忘了，如果哪天看到，我给你带过来。”
说到这里，他面现笑容，“嫂子，时间已经不早，我得去练刀了。”
也不等苏晴柔回应，几个大步便离开了厨房。
……………………
拔刀不停。
胳膊酸胀的时候，陈时安会将破军刀法拿出来琢磨研究。
偶尔，也会比划几刀。
同时，他买了一堆书回来，还会挤时间出来翻看一番，更好地了解这方世界。
原主就是个不学无术的草包，脑袋里没几分干货。
城建税如期交上，陈甜甜也上了私塾，苏晴柔的脸上终于出现了久违的笑容。
转眼之间，十天的时间过去。
苏晴柔已经熟练地掌握了豆豉和辣椒酱的做法，地窖里已经存放着十几坛成品辣椒酱，只等发酵完毕。
陈时安已经将破军刀法练熟，拔刀次数增加迅速，已经超过十五万之数。
尽管七千次之后，没有再出现洗髓伐骨，但他能感觉到，随着拔刀次数的增加，身体的力量、速度和强度都在缓慢地提升。
一切，似乎都在向着好的方向发展。
……………
这一日，已经到了散学的时间，陈甜甜却是还没回来。
苏晴柔不由有些担心，跟陈时安打了一声，便准备去私塾找寻。
还不等出门，陈甜甜回来了。
不过，她不像往日那般欢呼雀跃，并嚷着肚子饿，而是低着头、慢腾腾地迈过门槛。

抬起头时，泪水在眼眶里打转，左眼下面，还有一块明显的淤青。
“甜甜，你这是怎么了，和人打架了？”苏晴柔大惊失色，疾步奔了过去。
陈时安也收了横刀，眉头轻皱。
“母亲，我不想上私塾了。”陈甜甜的声音带着哭腔。
“怎么了？你快跟母亲说说。”
苏晴柔一把将女儿抱在怀中，轻轻触碰她脸上的淤青，“疼么？”
陈甜甜终于忍不住眼泪，哇哇大哭。
“甜甜，发生什么事了，你倒是和母亲说啊。”苏晴柔轻轻地拍着女儿的后背，心疼不已。
陈甜甜哭了一阵，才眼泪婆娑地说道：“他骂我，还撕了我的书，说我没了爹，叔叔又是个废物赌棍，早晚要被赶出城寨，没资格和他一起念私塾。”
听到这番话，苏晴柔被勾动起心中深藏的悲哀，竟也跟着落起泪来。
一时间，母女俩抱在一起，泣不成声。
陈时安本想上前安慰，但想了想，没有做出动作，静静地站在一旁。
苏晴柔和陈甜甜这半年里积攒着太多的悲伤，哭出来，也是好事。
足足一炷香的时间之后，院子里的哭声才停了下来。
“母亲，你去把学费退掉，我不去私塾了。”陈甜甜低低出声。
苏晴柔眼神犹豫，正要说话，却是听到院外响起了急促的脚步声。
只见，有四人怒气冲冲地踏过院门，三大一小。
三位精壮汉子，外加一个长得白白胖胖、脸上有一道两寸血痕的半大小子。
为首的，是一位满脸横肉的红脸男子。
陈时安认得此人，张麻子，在街头开着一间肉铺，天生大力，脾气暴躁。

做起生意来，对富人和有权势的人，阿谀巴结；对不如他的人，向来是缺斤短两。
那个白胖的半大小子一进门，便指着陈甜甜，高声道：“爹，就是她抓的我。”
陈甜甜看到这个架势，明显有些害怕，连忙躲到了苏晴柔的身后。
“苏晴柔，原来你家的妮子欺负我儿子。”
张麻子将儿子推到前面，“你看看你女儿干的好事，将我儿子给抓破了相。
你说，这事该怎么办？”
说话之时，跟在他身后的两位肉铺伙计往前踏出一步，俱是眼神不善地盯着苏晴柔母女。
张麻子等人自然看到了陈时安，但都选择了无视。
陈时安也没急着出面，静静地站在一旁。
苏晴柔眼看对方气势汹汹，连忙拉着女儿，畏惧地往后退了退，“张屠户，你看看，你儿子也将我女儿给打伤了，险些伤到了眼睛…………。”
“即便伤到了眼睛，又能如何，你女儿的眼睛能有我儿子的脸重要？”
张麻子竖起一对又黑又粗的眉毛，“念在你男人新死，你们孤女寡母不容易，赔我一两银子，这事就这么算了。”
“一两银子！”苏晴柔大惊失色。
张麻子面现冷笑，“你若是拿不出一两银子，那就去我家当一个月的仆役，洗洗衣服做做饭，再端茶递水。”
说话之时，他的一双眼睛在苏晴柔的身上来回扫视，眼中尽是贪婪的光芒。
同是男人，看到张麻子的作态，陈时安立马就洞悉了他的意图。
哎，红颜祸水！
有时候，女人长得漂亮可不是好事，尤其是身处乱世，最容易招灾招难。
要解决眼前的麻烦，并不难。
但是，短短时间，先有赵德胜，后有张麻子，若是不借机杀鸡儆猴，后边指不定还有李冬瓜、王癞头……………

“是他先骂我，还先动的手，凭什么要我们赔银子？”陈甜甜愤怒出声。
“果然是一个牙尖嘴利的丫头！”
张麻子冷笑一声，“你还敢胡说八道，颠倒黑白，你爹不在了，我来替他教育你。”
说完，他大踏步向前，就要去捉陈甜甜。
陈甜甜吓得小脸煞白，连忙躲到苏晴柔的身后。
张麻子脚步不停，直接向着苏晴柔走去。
“张屠户，你要干什么？”苏晴柔大惊失色，正要后退，却见眼前一花，一道修长的身影来到身前，挡住了张麻子，正是陈时安。
陈时安的身量在风起城寨算是高的，最近又添了一身健壮的肌肉，但和孔武有力的张麻子比起来，却是矮了一大截。
站在他的面前，显得有几分纤细。
“陈时安？你这赌棍废物，也敢挡老子的道！你以为，你大哥还活着呢？给老子滚开！”
张麻子满脸的不屑，伸出蒲扇大的手掌，直接朝着陈时安的脑袋扇去。
陈时安像是被吓傻了一般，眼瞅着巴掌扇来，却是一动不动。
“小叔，赶紧躲啊。”
苏晴柔急急出声。
陈甜甜也是惊声急呼：“小叔！”
就在这个时候，陈时安动了，看似轻飘飘伸出手，却是一把抓住了张麻子的手腕，使得他的手顿在了半空，不能再前进半分。
张麻子一脸的惊讶，想要将手收回来，却感觉陈时安的手像一把铁钳一般，将自己的手紧紧箍住，一动不能动。
同时，他还看到，陈时安的一双眼睛正直勾勾地盯着，像两口漆黑的深井，仿佛有凶神怪兽藏匿于其间，使得他没来由地打了一个寒战。
张麻子杀猪无数，多少也沾了点杀气，眼神凶悍，寻常人被他瞪上一眼，心儿都会跟着一颤。
但此刻，他竟然不敢和陈时安对视。

因为，他从陈时安的双目中感受到了杀气。
不是杀猪的杀气，而是杀人的杀气。
“陈时安，你要干什么？这里是城寨，光天化日之下，你想干什么？”张麻子害怕了，急急出声，声音中明显带着几分颤抖。
见到张麻子前后的反差，苏晴柔母女和那两位肉铺的伙计，俱是面露疑惑之色。
陈时安松开了手，微微一笑，“我自然是想和你协商解决问题，都是街坊邻居，咱们有事好商量。”
张麻子咽了咽口水，“你侄女伤了我儿子，该不该拿出赔偿？”
陈甜甜不服气，正要说话，却见到陈时安朝着自己摇头。
这一次，陈甜甜没有再和陈时安抬杠，竟是乖巧地闭上了嘴巴。
“城寨是讲规矩的地方，你儿子被我侄女抓伤了脸，我们自然要做出赔偿。”陈时安面带浅笑。
张麻子一愣，他没有想到，陈时安居然这么好说话。
难道，他到底还是怕了我？
对，这小子虽然力气大得邪门，但没了他大哥，仍旧只是一个烂赌棍，我怕他作甚！
张麻子突然觉得手腕不痛了，昂起头颅，“还是我方才的意思，要么赔一两银子，要么让苏晴柔去我家当一个月的仆役。”
苏晴柔和陈甜甜看到张麻子的态度又变得强硬，俱是紧张害怕起来。
但看到正挡在身前的陈时安，她们的心里没来由地升起一股心安的感觉。
同时，苏晴柔也想起了陈时安之前说过的话，“放心，有我在，天塌不下来。”
“一两银子么？没问题！”
陈时安直接从怀中掏出一两碎银。
张麻子等人再次惊讶了。
孩子被抓破点皮，过几天就好了，哪里用得着赔偿。

苏晴柔可是这条街上有名的美女，馋她身子的男人不知凡几，张麻子也不例外。
如今，苏晴柔的丈夫死了，家里就一个烂赌棍的小叔，没了依靠，正是下手的好时机。
张麻子想什么来什么，自己的儿子居然和陈甜甜起了冲突，正好借题发挥。
千算万算，他没有料到，陈时安这个烂赌棍居然有如此惊人的力气。
更没有料到，时不时就要让大哥帮忙偿还赌债的陈时安，居然能轻易拿出一两银子。
不过，虽然没能拿下苏晴柔，但能得到一银子也不错，张麻子对这个结果还算满意。
陈时安掂了掂手中的银子，又一把揣回兜里，“我可以赔你一两银子，但不能现在就给你。”
张麻子竖起了眉头，“你这是什么意思？”
陈时安眼皮轻抬，“我今天若是把银子赔给了你，你不认账，明天又来找我扯皮，我该怎么办？
这样吧，你们去找些人过来做个见证，我立马就将银子给到你。”
张麻子稍作犹豫，朝着一位伙计努了努嘴。
伙计连忙转身，走出了院子。
片刻之后，伙计回转，身后跟着十数人，都是附近的街坊邻居。
“陈时安，见证人到了，你该给银子了吧？”张麻子冷声催促。
陈时安微微一笑，“不着急，我肯定会把银子给你。
但在给之前，我要把事情给各位街坊讲清楚。”
说完，他朝着一众街坊微微一拱手，
“各位街坊，我们陈家今日和张屠户闹了些许矛盾。
请大家过来，是希望大家能替我们做个见证，解决矛盾。
我们身在荒墟，能够得到城寨的庇护，是我们的幸运，自然要遵守城寨的规矩。

我的侄女抓伤了张屠户家的儿子。伤了人就要给赔偿，天经地义，这也是城寨的规矩，我们陈家不会抵赖。
现今，张屠户要我赔偿一两银子。”
听到这里，前来见证的街坊们立马变了脸色，纷纷低声议论起来：
“小孩子家打闹，抓破点脸皮，养两天就能恢复如初。张麻子居然要索赔一两银子，分明就是讹诈。”
“张麻子敢这么做，还不是看苏晴柔的男人死了，家里只剩下一个烂泥扶不上墙的小叔子，软柿子一个，好拿捏？”
“可怜呐，厄运最喜苦命人！陈家这是漏船又逢连夜雨。”
“哎！陈时安找我们过来，分明想要我们帮忙说和。张麻子最是蛮横霸道，谁敢得罪他。”
“苏晴柔的确可怜，但陈时安烂赌棍一个，可不值得同情。先前仗着大哥是城卫什长，没少在我们面前耀武扬威。现在要遭报应，活该！”
…………………
content_en:
"Tiantian, don't talk nonsense."
Su Qingrou spoke quickly, with a stern tone.
Chen Shi'an coughed awkwardly, "Girl, you can't just look at appearances. What you see may not be true.
My brother-in-law is a low-key person and never lets anyone see him when he is working hard in secret. "
Chen Tiantian curled her lips and was about to retort, but was pulled out of the kitchen by Su Qingrou.
"Brother-in-law, Tiantian has been spoiled by her father since she was a child, and she won't forgive others. Don't take it to heart." Su Qingrou came back quickly and apologized repeatedly.
Chen Shi'an shook his head, "Sister-in-law, don't be so cautious. Tiantian is my niece, how could I blame her.
Big brother is gone, I will protect you two from now on. "
Hearing this, Su Qingrou blinked her eyes, with water vapor rising faintly in her eyes.
"Sister-in-law, don't teach others how to make chili sauce. This is a big business that can make money."
Chen Shi'an put half a bag of soybeans on the stove, "When making chili sauce, tempeh is very important.
The tempeh you bought was not bad, but it was a little less interesting.
In the future, when you make chili sauce, you will need to make your own tempeh. "
Su Qingrou looked ashamed, "I have made black bean sauce before, but the taste is so bad that I can't make it well."
Chen Shi'an smiled slightly, "Isn't it still me? I'll watch you do it, and I'll tell you where you need to improve."
After speaking, he found a bucket and poured the soybeans in. "The time for soaking the beans is very important. In summer, it takes three to four hours. Now that it is winter, the time needs to be doubled.
Soak it now and we can start making it at noon tomorrow. "
Su Qingrou's face showed a look of surprise, "It turns out that it takes so long to soak. I was wrong from the beginning.
Did you learn these things from books?
What kind of book is this? Why have I never seen it before? Is it sold in the walled city? "
Chen Shi'an scratched his head and said, "The books I read were too miscellaneous. I forgot exactly what book it was. If I see it one day, I will bring it to you."
Having said this, he smiled and said, "Sister-in-law, it's getting late, I have to go practice swordsmanship."
Without waiting for Su Qingrou's response, she left the kitchen in a few strides.
……………………
He kept drawing his sword.
When his arms are sore, Chen Shi'an will take out the saber-breaking technique and study it.
Occasionally, I will make a few gestures.
At the same time, he bought a bunch of books and would find time to read them to better understand the world.
The original owner was an uneducated idiot with little practical knowledge in his head.
The urban construction tax was paid as scheduled, Chen Tiantian also attended private school, and a long-lost smile finally appeared on Su Qingrou's face.
In the blink of an eye, ten days passed.
Su Qingrou has mastered the making of tempeh and chili sauce, and there are already more than a dozen jars of finished chili sauce stored in the cellar, just waiting for fermentation to be completed.
Chen Shi'an has mastered the saber-breaking technique, and the number of times he draws his sword has increased rapidly, reaching more than 150,000.
Although there was no more bone marrow cleaning after seven thousand times, he could feel that as the number of times he drew the sword increased, his body's strength, speed and intensity were slowly increasing.
Everything seems to be moving in a good direction.
……………
On this day, it was time for school to end, but Chen Tiantian hadn't come back yet.
Su Qingrou couldn't help but feel worried. She called Chen Shi'an and prepared to go to the private school to look for him.
Before leaving the house, Chen Tiantian came back.
However, instead of cheering and complaining about being hungry as usual, she lowered her head and slowly crossed the threshold.
When he raised his head, tears welled up in his eyes, and there was an obvious bruise under his left eye.
"Tiantian, what's wrong with you? Did you get into a fight?" Su Qingrou was shocked and ran over quickly.
Chen Shi'an also put away the horizontal sword and frowned slightly.
"Mom, I don't want to go to private school anymore." Chen Tiantian's voice was filled with tears.cavity.
"What's wrong? Tell your mother quickly."
Su Qingrou held her daughter in her arms and gently touched the bruises on her face, "Does it hurt?"
Chen Tiantian finally couldn't hold back her tears and burst into tears.
"Tiantian, what happened, you should tell your mother." Su Qingrou patted her daughter's back gently, feeling distressed.
Chen Tiantian cried for a while, and then said with tears rolling down her cheeks: "He scolded me and tore up my book. He said that I had no father and that my uncle was a good-for-nothing gambler. He would be kicked out of the city sooner or later, and he was not qualified to attend a private school with him."
Hearing these words, Su Qingrou was aroused by the deep sorrow in her heart, and she also shed tears.
For a moment, the mother and daughter hugged each other and burst into tears.
Chen Shi'an wanted to step forward to comfort him, but after thinking about it, he made no move and stood quietly aside.
Su Qingrou and Chen Tiantian have accumulated too much sadness in the past six months, so it is a good thing to cry.
After a full stick of incense, the crying in the yard stopped.
"Mom, go and refund the tuition fees. I won't go to private school anymore." Chen Tiantian said in a low voice.
Su Qingrou's eyes hesitated, and when she was about to speak, she heard rapid footsteps outside the hospital.
I saw four people angrily stepping through the courtyard gate, three large and one small.
Three strong men, plus a little boy who was fair and fat and had a two-inch blood mark on his face.
The leader was a red-faced man with a sinister face.
Chen Shi'an recognized this man, Zhang Mazi, who ran a butcher shop on the street. He was naturally strong and had a bad temper.
When doing business, he always flatters the rich and powerful; he always treats those who are not as good as him.
As soon as the fat and fair boy entered the door, he pointed at Chen Tiantian and said loudly: "Dad, she was the one who caught me."
Chen Tiantian was obviously a little scared when she saw this posture, and hurriedly hid behind Su Qingrou.
"Su Qingrou, it turns out that your girl bullied my son."
Zhang Mazi pushed his son forward and said, "Look at the good things your daughter did, she scratched my son's face.
Tell me, what should we do about this? "
While speaking, the two butcher shop assistants following him took a step forward, both staring at Su Qingrou and her daughter with unkind eyes.
Zhang Mazi and others naturally saw Chen Shi'an, but they chose to ignore it.
Chen Shi'an was not in a hurry to come forward and stood quietly aside.
Su Qingrou saw that the other party was so aggressive that she quickly pulled her daughter and backed away in fear, "Butcher Zhang, look, your son also injured my daughter, almost hurting her eyes..."
"Even if the eyes are hurt, so what? Are your daughter's eyes as important as my son's face?"
Zhang Mazi raised a pair of black and thick eyebrows, "Since your man has recently died, it will be difficult for you, an orphan and a widowed mother. Please pay me a tael of silver and let this be settled."
"One tael of silver!" Su Qingrou was shocked.
Zhang Mazi had a sneer on his face, "If you can't spare a tael of silver, then work as a servant in my house for a month, washing clothes, cooking, and serving tea and water."
While speaking, his eyes glanced back and forth on Su Qingrou's body, his eyes filled with greedy light.
They were both men. Seeing Zhang Mazi's behavior, Chen Shi'an immediately understood his intentions.
Alas, beauty is a curse!
Sometimes, it is not a good thing for a woman to be beautiful, especially in troubled times, when she is most likely to attract disaster.
It is not difficult to solve the immediate trouble.
However, in a short period of time, first there was Zhao Desheng, and then there was Zhang Mazi. If we didn’t take the opportunity to scare the monkeys, there might be Li Donggua and Wang Shoutou next...
"He scolded me first and made a move first. Why should we pay for it?" Chen Tiantian said angrily.
"She is indeed a sharp-tongued girl!"
Zhang Mazi sneered, "You still dare to talk nonsense and confuse right and wrong. Your father is gone, and I will educate you for him."
After saying that, he strode forward, we have to catch Chen Tiantian.
Chen Tiantian's face turned pale with fright, and she quickly hid behind Su Qingrou.
Zhang Mazi walked directly towards Su Qingrou without stopping.
"Butcher Zhang, what are you going to do?" Su Qingrou was shocked and was about to retreat when she saw a blur in front of her eyes. A slender figure came in front of her and blocked Zhang Mazi. It was Chen Shi'an.
Chen Shi'an is considered tall in Fengqi City Walled City and has recently gained a strong body of muscles, but compared to the powerful Zhang Mazi, he is a lot shorter.
Standing in front of him, she looked a bit slender.
"Chen Shi'an? You're such a loser as a gambler, how dare you stand in my way! Do you think your eldest brother is still alive? Get out of my way!"
With disdain on his face, Zhang Mazi stretched out his hand as big as a cattail leaf fan and slapped Chen Shi'an directly on the head.
Chen Shi'an seemed to be stunned, watching the slap coming, but remained motionless.
"Uncle, hide quickly."
Su Qingrou spoke urgently.
Chen Tiantian also shouted in shock: "Uncle!"
At this moment, Chen Shi'an moved. He seemed to reach out lightly, but he grabbed Zhang Mazi's wrist, causing his hand to freeze in mid-air and unable to move forward for another half minute.
Zhang Mazi looked surprised and wanted to take his hand back, but felt that Chen Shi'an's hand was like a pair of iron pliers, tightly holding his hand, unable to move.
At the same time, he also saw that Chen Shi'an's eyes were staring straight at him, like two deep dark wells, as if there were fierce monsters hiding in them, which made him shiver for no reason.
Zhang Mazi killed countless pigs, and he had a bit of murderous intent. His eyes were so fierce that ordinary people's hearts would tremble if they were stared at by him.
But at this moment, he didn't dare to look at Chen Shi'an.
Because he felt murderous intent from Chen Shi'an's eyes.
Not the murderous intent of killing pigs, but the murderous intent of killing people.
"Chen Shi'an, what do you want to do? This is a walled city, in broad daylight, what do you want to do?" Zhang Mazi was frightened and spoke hurriedly, his voice obviously trembling.
Seeing the contrast between Zhang Mazi before and after, Su Qingrou, her daughter, and the two butcher shop clerks all looked puzzled.
Chen Shi'an let go of his hand and smiled slightly, "Of course I want to negotiate with you to solve the problem. We are all neighbors. We have things to discuss."
Zhang Mazi swallowed, "Your niece hurt my son, should I pay compensation?"
Chen Tiantian was unconvinced and was about to speak when she saw Chen Shi'an shaking his head towards her.
This time, Chen Tiantian didn't argue with Chen Shi'an anymore, and actually kept her mouth shut obediently.
"The Walled City is a place with rules. Your son was scratched on the face by my niece, so of course we have to make compensation." Chen Shi'an said with a smile.
Zhang Mazi was stunned. He didn't expect that Chen Shi'an was so easy to talk to.
Could it be that he is still afraid of me?
Yes, although this boy is extremely powerful, without his elder brother, he is still just a bad gambler. I am afraid of what he will do!
Zhang Mazi suddenly felt that the pain in his wrist was gone, and he raised his head, "It's what I just wanted, either to pay one tael of silver, or to let Su Qingrou work as a servant in my house for a month."
Su Qingrou and Chen Tiantian became nervous and frightened when they saw Zhang Mazi's attitude becoming tough again.
But when they saw Chen Shi'an standing in front of them, they felt a sense of peace of mind for no reason.
At the same time, Su Qingrou also remembered what Chen Shi'an said before, "Don't worry, as long as I'm here, the sky won't fall."
"One tael of silver? No problem!"
Chen Shi'an took out a tael of silver directly from his pocket.
Zhang Mazi and others were surprised again.
If the child is scratched, he will be fine in a few days, so there is no need for compensation.
Su Qingrou is a famous beauty on this street. There are countless men who are greedy for her body, and Zhang Mazi is no exception.
Now, Su Qingrou's husband is dead, and her uncle, a bad gambler, has no one to rely on.It's a good time to start.
Zhang Mazi got whatever he wanted, and his son actually had a conflict with Chen Tiantian, so he just used the topic as an excuse.
After all, he never expected that Chen Shi'an, a bad gambler, would have such amazing strength.
What's more, he didn't expect that Chen Shi'an, who had to ask his elder brother to help pay off his gambling debts from time to time, could easily come up with a tael of silver.
However, although he failed to win Su Qingrou, it was not bad to get one silver. Zhang Mazi was quite satisfied with the result.
Chen Shi'an weighed the money in his hand and put it back into his pocket, "I can compensate you a tael of silver, but I can't give it to you now."
Zhang Mazi raised his eyebrows, "What do you mean?"
Chen Shi'an raised his eyelids slightly, "If I compensate you with money today, but you don't acknowledge it, and you come to argue with me tomorrow, what should I do?
Let's do this, you go find some people to come and bear witness, and I will give you the money right away. "
Zhang Mazi hesitated for a moment and nuzzled at a waiter.
The guy turned around quickly and walked out of the yard.
After a while, the guy turned around, followed by a dozen people, all of whom were nearby neighbors.
"Chen Shi'an, the witnesses are here, should you give them some money?" Zhang Mazi urged coldly.
Chen Shi'an smiled slightly and said, "Don't worry, I will definitely give you the money.
But before I give it, I want to explain things clearly to all the neighbors. "
After saying that, he slightly arched his hands toward the neighbors.
"Dear neighbors, our Chen family had some conflicts with Butcher Zhang today.
We invite everyone to come here in the hope that you can bear witness for us and resolve conflicts.
We are in the ruins, and we are lucky to be protected by the walled city. Naturally, we must abide by the rules of the walled city.
My niece scratched Zhang Butcher’s son. If you hurt someone, you must pay compensation. It is a matter of course and it is also the rule of the city. Our Chen family will not deny it.
Now, Butcher Zhang wants me to pay one tael of silver in compensation. "
Upon hearing this, the faces of the neighbors who came to witness immediately changed, and they all started talking in low voices:
"Children are playing around at home, and if they scratch their skin, they will be back to their original state in two days. Zhang Mazi actually wants to claim a tael of silver, which is obviously blackmail."
"Zhang Mazi dares to do this, isn't it because Su Qingrou's man is dead and the family is left with a brother-in-law who can't hold up the wall and is a soft persimmon who can be easily handled?"
"Poor misfortune, misfortune loves the poor most! The Chen family is in trouble and it rains all night."
"Hey! Chen Shi'an came to us. He clearly wants our help in making peace. Zhang Mazi is the most arrogant and domineering person. Who dares to offend him."
"Su Qingrou is indeed pitiful, but Chen Shi'an is a rotten gambler and does not deserve sympathy. Previously, because his eldest brother was the chief of the city guard, he often showed off his power in front of us. Now he will be punished, and he deserves it!"
